title: Seattle Host City Finances Under Scrutiny: FIFA Takes Venue Revenue While City Bears Security Costs
detail: Analysis of Seattle's financial obligations as a World Cup host city reveals a stark imbalance: FIFA collects stadium venue revenues while the city shoulders infrastructure, security, and logistics costs. The arrangement raises questions about net public benefit for taxpayers ahead of the tournament, a pattern repeated across all 16 host cities in the United States, Canada, and Mexico.
